nodes.name: Client / SDK
nodes.description: Streams chat responses over SSE; sends tenant-scoped access tokens and uploads documents.

nodes.name: Load balancer
nodes.description: TLS termination, WAF checks and health-aware distribution across two availability zones.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.description: Request validation, tenant quotas and JWT enforcement. Routes /chat, /jobs and /documents.

nodes.name: Identity & RBAC
nodes.description: OIDC / JWKS verification, tenant membership and role checks. Short-lived service identities.

nodes.name: Chat API · 3 pods
nodes.description: mTLS + tenant guards inside each pod. Loads conversation history and streams model output.

nodes.name: Workflow API · 2 pods
nodes.description: Authorizes batch jobs, stores idempotency keys and publishes durable ingestion tasks.

nodes.name: RAG retrieval
nodes.description: Tenant-filtered hybrid search, reranking and citation assembly. No cross-tenant context.

nodes.name: LLM router & policy
nodes.description: PII policy, token budgets, circuit breakers and provider fallback. Private data stays on internal models.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Tenant membership, conversations and audit records. Row-level security and encrypted backups.

nodes.name: Redis
nodes.description: Atomic rate limits, short-lived identity caches and per-tenant token budgets.

nodes.name: Vector database
nodes.description: Embeddings and searchable chunks partitioned by tenant. Hybrid similarity + metadata filtering.

nodes.name: NATS JetStream
nodes.description: Durable job streams, explicit acknowledgments and dead-letter handling after bounded retries.

nodes.name: Ingestion workers · 4 pods
nodes.description: Service-account auth, document parsing, chunking and embeddings. Retries safely without duplicate writes.

nodes.name: Object storage · S3
nodes.description: Encrypted uploads, signed URLs and lifecycle retention. Separate object prefixes for each tenant.

nodes.name: Private inference · vLLM
nodes.description: GPU-backed model pods behind a private endpoint. Embeddings + completions; no public egress.

nodes.name: External LLM APIs
nodes.description: OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic APIs via controlled egress. Redacted prompts, request deadlines and usage metering.
